اذدكرتن (form VIII)
# اِذْدَكَرْتُنَّ (iḏdakartunna) /ið.da.kar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# اُذْدُكِرْتُنَّ (uḏdukirtunna) /uð.du.kir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
